faq.q: What does Khwaja mean in Persian?

faq.a: Romanization variants include Khwaja, khwaja. Script forms are خواجة, خواجه, خواجہ, ख़्वाजा.

faq.q: Is Khwaja a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
